algorithm.flow: Offer then admit each valid record. At16 retained records call re_process(ctx,1) once. Save search stop/fraction before one postcommit re_query(ctx,0,1) at bank.estimate. Also make exactly one initial empty-block query.
algorithm.initialization: re_init uses public mean and empty bank; no historical candidate input.
algorithm.success_semantics: CH_OK from process means a valid merge, not convergence. Preserve unresolved stops and approximation flags.
algorithm.work_cap_derivation: At most11 queries/block plus initial1,10 prior evaluations/block plus initial1,16*(11 query passes+1 merge pass)*31500 attempted model steps. Rejected fractions consume finite work; counters reserve actual model calls before each recurrence.

likelihood.law: Point Gaussian voltage residual conditional on decoded current/time and quantized voltage; approximate quantized-input likelihood.
likelihood.prior: Original public supported joint mixture once in the original entering16D chart; no density Jacobian from proposal coordinates.

study_fixture.producer_domain: Ordered contiguous index;0<=actual_dt<=1 s and |I|<=0.25 A. Decode and validate engineering outputs before offering to candidate.
study_fixture.provenance: Explicit synthetic-study configuration, selected before archive outcomes; not user hardware specifications.
study_fixture.quantization: Reject nonfinite/outside-calibrated-span values before rounding. For nonnegative q use floor(q+0.5), with exact half ties toward the higher code/tick. No clipping.
study_fixture.statistics: For successfully encoded records, report decoded-minus-original dt/I/V signed sum, mean, RMS, maximum absolute error, half-tie counts and channel rail counts.
study_fixture.temperature_scope: Archive contains no T; synthesized25 C only. No temperature compensation or physical ADC calibration accuracy claim.
study_fixture.voltage_range_reason: Source support has |I|<=0.25, R0/Ri<=1, |vi|<=0.25, H<=0.1 and |h|<=1. With0<=SOC<=1 its conservative terminal-voltage envelope is approximately1.82..5.33 V. The broader dyadic map covers that envelope; unbounded Gaussian noise still requires explicit overflow failure.
